runs.reviewer: Separate case-authoring Codex agent provisional review

D-01.note: Correctly captures recurring oily film of unestablished origin and investigation before return to service; no diagnosis or invented delay linkage.

D-02.note: Correct historical absence of the written release and its signed September 10 receipt/closure. The material opposing verbal-clearance / QC-passed accounts from D02 and D03 are not selected, so the specifically defined conflict is only partially identified.

D-03.note: Explicit 6 mm versus 9 mm conflict, internal draft, and later signed TQ-061 / M-214 revision D decision specifying 9 mm with closed status.

D-04.note: The same supported finding separately quotes the draft not issued through the register and lack of installer receipt, followed by formal issue at 13:10 and acknowledged receipt at 13:35. Counts this reference once despite sharing F3 with D-03.

D-05.note: No selected finding retains the documented September 9 and 10 pump-setting deferrals with later September 12 physical setting/grouting completion. F3 retains design-history passages but does not describe the actual work postponement or subsequent physical completion. The v12 partial physical-completion item is absent from this v15 output.

D-06.note: Separately identifies anchor-torque witness acceptance, the later AT-P6-0912 reference, and the unlinked/unavailable signed sheet. Needs-verification status correctly avoids asserting inspection failure or non-occurrence.

D-07.note: Explicitly captures the one-bag reconciliation gap with 22 received, 19 issued, and two returned; later mixing of those 19 does not resolve the gap. No invented excess volume, theft, or quality defect.

D-08.note: Captures preliminary 0.18 mm vertical offset versus 0.10 mm limit and final alignment required after cure before start-up. Correct open status and no claim of failed final acceptance or current operation.

D-09.note: F9 correctly retains the 80-minute restriction, reassignment and resumed work, and F7 correctly quotes uncertain notice receipt. Neither item retains D08's explicit account that a notice was sent on September 11. The reference requires the reported-sending versus uncertain-receipt distinction; that opposing/contextual account was present in v15 F7 but is absent here.

findingNotes.F1: Supported recurring oily-film cause still unknown, with investigation required before return to service and no invented diagnosis.
findingNotes.F2: Supported historical missing written bearing-face release and correct explicit signed later closure. Partial D-02 coverage because the verbal clearance and QC-passed opposing claims remain absent.
findingNotes.F3: Supported 6 mm versus 9 mm technical conflict and unissued internal draft, followed by formal signed revision, crew receipt, and closed technical question. Fully covers D-03 and D-04.
findingNotes.F4: Supported separate anchor-torque record-verification gap: installer work done, later inspection reference present, signed acceptance sheet unlinked/unavailable. No claim of failed or never-conducted inspection.
findingNotes.F5: Supported one-bag quantity gap with consistent source values and open reconciliation state.
findingNotes.F6: Supported preliminary 0.18 mm alignment versus 0.10 mm limit and final alignment requirement before start-up.
findingNotes.F7: Supported narrow notice-receipt uncertainty; no false assertion that notice was never sent. However, the selected evidence omits the Principal Contractor's reported sending account, so this plus F9 only partially covers the complete D-09 reference.
findingNotes.F8: Supported additional remaining cure task under the established broader closeout rubric. Correct future release/proceeding-to-plan language and update category; no invented overdue, delay, or failure claim. No new reference issue is added.
findingNotes.F9: Supported historical 80-minute restriction, technicians' reassignment, and resumed rack access. Complements F7 but does not restore the omitted reported-sending account.
